{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# The revenue column contains thousands separators, e.g., '1,234.56'
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check if any QA orders were missed (should be 0)
qa_in_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"QA orders in completed set: {qa_in_completed.shape[0]}")

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")"}
